sampling_estimate.definition: vx>=0.5, |vy|<=0.1, |executed yaw rate|<=0.1 m/s or rad/s
assumptions: low vx group uniform [-1,1] on non-flat
heading targets uniform [-pi,pi] independent of current heading
uniform independent resamples; not an observed training frequency
sampling_estimate.normal_pyramid_spawn: central top platform, x/y random offsets +/-0.5 inside 3m platform: initial traversal is descending
sampling_estimate.inverted_pyramid_spawn: central bottom platform: initial traversal is ascending
sampling_estimate.terrain_curriculum: radial distance >4m promotes; distance <command speed*20*.5 demotes; no explicit successful ascent signal

reproducibility.interpretation: Identical initial states/DR and deterministic actor; GPU contact simulation is not bitwise reproducible over long horizons. Compare aggregate outcomes, not exact long trajectories.

reward_semantics.raw_reconstruction: step_reward / weight; zero-weight terms not present
reward_semantics.robot_state_timestamp: inside reward compute before final forward; derived quantities lag one 0.005s physics step, matching reward inputs
